begin

--

 and sysdate between e.eff_date and nvl(e.term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception

 check_package_failure;
 end;

 end if;
end;

declare -- Jairam added per IM 5313 to make sure its showing 8030 error if eff date entered is less than current date. on 22-apr-2011
 v_local_time date;

begin

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);

-- above code by jairam


--begin

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if ((:EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_value is null) and
 (:EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.required_flag = 'Y')) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- If there is a LOV item for this detail, validate that detail is defined in the equip_master_codes table
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 if ((:equipment_parm_values.valid_code is not null) and 
 (:equipment_parm_values.parm_value is not null)) then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_master_codes emc
 where emc.code_type = :equipment_parm_values.valid_code
 and emc.code = :equipment_parm_values.parm_value
 and sysdate between emc.eff_date and nvl(emc.term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--
-- If this is a numeric or date field, validate the entry to insure it is in proper format
-- number
 if ((:equipment_parm_values.type_of_data = 'NUMBER') and 
 (:equipment_parm_values.parm_value is not null)) then
 begin
 select to_number(:equipment_parm_values.parm_value) into :GLOBAL.x from dual;
 exception
 when others then
 show_error ('8020');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--
-- validate date field format
--
 if ((:equipment_parm_values.type_of_data = 'DATE') and 
 (:equipment_parm_values.parm_value is not null)) then
 begin
 select to_char(to_date(:equipment_parm_values.parm_value, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'MM-DD-YY')
 into :equipment_parm_values.parm_value
 from dual;
 exception
 when others then
 show_error ('9191');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--
-- validate datetime field format
--
 if ((:equipment_parm_values.type_of_data = 'DATETIME') and 
 (:equipment_parm_values.parm_value is not null)) then
 begin
 select to_char(to_date(:equipment_parm_values.parm_value, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') 
 into :equipment_parm_values.parm_value from dual;
 exception
 when others then
 show_error ('1708');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POP_EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES IS

 v_local_time date; -- jairam added per IM 5313
 
 CURSOR EPV_DATA IS
 select vp.arrange_by, vp.ref_number, vp.parm_desc, vp.required_flag, vp.valid_code, vp.type_of_data
 from VEQUIP_PARMS VP
 where VP.EQUIP_TYPE = :CTRL_BLK_1.EQUIPMENT_TYPE
 and v_local_time between vp.eff_date and nvl(vp.term_date, v_local_time+1)
 ORDER BY VP.arrange_by;
 
 
 
BEGIN 
 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time); 
 
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if; 
-- above code by jairam
 
 
 
 FOR C1 IN EPV_DATA LOOP
 BEGIN
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_reference := :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.ref_number := C1.ref_number;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.arrange_by := C1.arrange_by;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_desc := C1.parm_desc;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_value := NULL;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.required_flag := C1.required_flag;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.valid_code := C1.valid_code;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.type_of_data := C1.type_of_data;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.last_modified_date := sysdate;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.modified_by := :BANNER.user_id;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.audit_key := NULL;
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.program_id := 'EQIENTER';
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.s_seq_no := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 NEXT_RECORD; 
 END;
 END LOOP;
 GO_RECORD (1);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REF_EQUIP_PARMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REF_EQUIP_PARMS IS
BEGIN
 WHILE (:EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.ref_number is not null) LOOP
 :EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.equip_reference := :EQUIPMENT.equip_reference;
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record ('1');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EQUIP_PARM_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_EQUIP_PARM_VALUES IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.current_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 GO_RECORD ('1');
 while (:equipment_parm_values.ref_number is not null) loop
 begin
 if ((:EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.parm_value is null) and
 (:EQUIPMENT_PARM_VALUES.required_flag = 'Y')) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 end;
 end loop;
 GO_RECORD (:GLOBAL.current_record);
END;

Trigger.Name: EQUIP_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :GLOBAL.current_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.current_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
--
 if(:SYSTEM.block_status != 'CHANGED') then
 show_error ('8013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.serial_number is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('serial_number');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.location is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('location');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.received_date is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('received_date');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.usage_hours is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('usage_hours');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.usage_days is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('usage_days');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.status is null) then
 :EQUIPMENT.status := 'NEW';
 end if;
-- check detail block
 go_block ('equipment_parm_values');
 VALIDATE_EQUIP_PARM_VALUES;
 check_package_failure;
--
 :equipment.qualification_flag := 'N';
 :equipment.last_modified_date := sysdate;
 :equipment.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
 :equipment.audit_key := null;
 :equipment.program_id := 'EQIENTER';
 :equipment.note_id := null;
--
 LOCK TABLE equipment in exclusive mode;
--
 if (:EQUIPMENT.equip_reference is null) then
 select 'EQ-'||substr(to_char(to_number(nvl(max(
 substr(equip_reference,4)),0))+1,'099999'),2,6)
 into :EQUIPMENT.equip_reference
 from equipment;
 :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference := :EQUIPMENT.equip_reference;
 end if;
 go_block ('equipment_parm_values');
 go_record ('1');
 ref_equip_parms;
 go_record ('1');
 go_block (:GLOBAL.current_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.current_item);
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 show_error ('0000');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level :=0;
end;
